meta.title: Kaffi Duus — Restaurant by the Harbor
meta.description: Kaffi Duus — fresh seafood and dining by the small boat harbor in Keflavík, Iceland. Hotel Duus rooms, harbor views, and reservations.

hero.tagline: Where the fresh catch meets the harbor view. Experience authentic Icelandic dining with a modern twist.

story.title: Dining with a View Since 1997
story.p1: Located by the picturesque small boat harbor in Keflavík, Kaffi Duus started as a small coffee house but has grown into one of the most popular restaurants in the area.
story.p2: We pride ourselves on offering fresh seafood straight from the harbor, perfectly grilled meats, and our famous desserts. Whether you're here for a romantic dinner or a relaxed evening, the view over the ocean creates the perfect atmosphere.
story.imageAlt: Dining room at Kaffi Duus with booths, bar, and windows overlooking the coast

hotel.title: Stay by the Harbor
hotel.p1: Connected to Kaffi Duus restaurant, our boutique hotel offers the perfect base for exploring Iceland's Reykjanes peninsula. Fall asleep to the sound of the ocean and wake up to a freshly prepared breakfast downstairs.
hotel.p2: Each room is designed with Scandinavian simplicity and Icelandic character — natural materials, warm lighting, and views that remind you exactly where you are.

single-ocean-view.name: Single Ocean View
single-ocean-view.tagline: Solo stay with an ocean outlook
single-ocean-view.description: A single room facing the ocean—ideal when you are traveling alone and want a clear view of the coast from Hotel Duus.
single-ocean-view.details: This room is set up for one guest with the amenities listed for our property, including a small kitchenette area (refrigerator, coffee maker, kettle), Wi-Fi, TV, and a balcony. City tax applies per night in addition to the room rate shown at booking.

double-ocean-view.name: Double Room — Ocean View
double-ocean-view.description: A double room with an ocean view at Hotel Duus—well suited for couples or two guests who want the Atlantic outside the window.
double-ocean-view.details: Standard and non-refundable rate options are available in our booking engine. The room includes the property amenities listed below. All room prices include 11% VAT; city tax is added per room per night at invoicing. Pets are not allowed.

double-parking-view.name: Double Room — Parking View
double-parking-view.tagline: Quiet double room with a parking-side outlook
double-parking-view.description: A double room with a parking-view orientation—another way to stay at Hotel Duus when you prefer this layout.
double-parking-view.details: Features align with our other double rooms (kitchenette basics, Wi-Fi, balcony, and more). Check live availability and EUR rates for your dates in the booking portal.

double-twin-ocean-view.name: Double/Twin — Ocean View
double-twin-ocean-view.tagline: Ocean view as a double or twin
double-twin-ocean-view.description: Configure as a double or twin in our ocean-view category—flexible for two travelers who want separate beds or one bed.
double-twin-ocean-view.details: Select dates and guest count in the booking engine to see which rate plans apply. The same core in-room facilities apply as for our other ocean-view doubles.

superior-ocean-view.name: Superior Ocean View
superior-ocean-view.description: Our superior ocean-view category offers an elevated take on the coastal outlook, with the same trusted Hotel Duus in-room facilities.
superior-ocean-view.details: Promotional and non-refundable options may appear for selected dates in the booking engine (for example winter promotions). Always confirm rate rules before you complete a reservation.

family-parking-view.name: Family Room — Parking View
family-parking-view.description: A family-oriented room with a parking-view side of the property—ideal when you need more space for adults and children together.
family-parking-view.details: Guest limits and extra-bed rules for children apply as set by the hotel in the booking flow. Full payment and cancellation rules depend on the rate plan you choose (standard vs non-refundable).
